question: Should the package/update owner accept this PR's opt-in local override replay contract and legacy content-inventory compatibility list as the intended update boundary?
rationale: The code appears correct after review, but it changes a compatibility- and security-sensitive package update path where maintainer ownership must decide the permanent product contract.

options.title: Finish package-owner review

options.title: Accept the current contract

options.title: Split the behavior
